text.hi: किताब कहती है: लाइब्रेरी से भूत की कहानियाँ पढ़ो और छोटे वाक्यों में दोस्तों को सुनाओ। चलो एक मज़ेदार छोटी कहानी के वाक्य बोलते हैं।
text.hinglish: Kitaab kehti hai: library se bhoot ki kahaaniyaan padho aur chhote vaakyon mein doston ko sunaao. Chalo ek mazedaar chhoti kahani ke vaakya bolte hain.
text.en: The book says: read ghost stories from the library and tell them in short sentences. Let's say the lines of a funny little story.

steps.sentence: One night, Raju saw something white in the garden.

meaning.hi: एक रात राजू ने बगीचे में कुछ सफ़ेद देखा।
meaning.hinglish: Ek raat Raju ne bageeche mein kuch safed dekha.
meaning.en: One night, Raju saw something white in the garden.

steps.sentence: He was very scared and called his father.

meaning.hi: वह बहुत डर गया और उसने पापा को बुलाया।
meaning.hinglish: Woh bahut dar gaya aur usne papa ko bulaaya.
meaning.en: He was very scared and called his father.

steps.sentence: It was only a white shirt on the clothes line!

meaning.hi: वह तो बस रस्सी पर टँगी एक सफ़ेद कमीज़ थी!
meaning.hinglish: Woh to bas rassi par tangi ek safed kameez thi!
meaning.en: It was only a white shirt on the clothes line!

steps.question: What is the lesson of ‘The White Visitor’?

questionMeaning.hi: ‘The White Visitor’ की सीख क्या है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: ‘The White Visitor’ ki seekh kya hai?

options: Be brave and find out the truth.
steps.answer: Be brave and find out the truth.
